kind.description: Marks this file as an inventory.

Inventory.title: Trayful inventory
Inventory.description: The physical contents of the box: which components exist and how many.

type.description: Component type id from a library.

count.description: Copies of each design in this entry. Default 1.

deck.description: Group these components into a named deck that spawns as one stack.

data.description: Field values shared by every component in this entry.

items.description: One row per design, each with its own field values.

from.description: CSV file with one row per design. The header row names the fields; a `count` column is allowed.

each.description: Make one design per combination of these field values, e.g. `{ color: [red, blue] }`.

InventoryEntry.description: A group of components of one type. Use at most one of `items`, `from` or `each`; with none, the entry is one design.

InventoryRow.description: Field values for one design. Keys are the type's fields, plus optional `count` (copies, default 1) and `id` (a stable id prefix).
